messages:
maria: heads-up — hf->rw conversion for hf/galactica-3b-staging failed during safetensors fetch, convert-bot aborted with 403 on chunk 12 and local shard ordering looks permuted.

convert-bot: ERROR download failed 403 (token expired) while fetching safetensors shard 00012-of-00032; attempted resume but checksum mismatch; aborting conversion.

aj: did we accidentally un-pin the hub revision? i pushed a tiny packaging change to refs/heads/staging last night, could explain mismatch.

devon: i re-ran with --log-level=debug and --stream-chunks; fetcher is parallel (8 workers) and writes shards as they finish, but later concat assumes numeric order -> ends up with shard_00012 before shard_00009. so final file permuted.

sophie: also spotted config.json drift: converter expects "lm_head.weight" but upstream has renamed to "lm_head_dense.weight" — key rename mapping missing, special tokens drop when the head layer mapping fails.

maria: can you paste the small config snippet that caused the lookup to fail?

devon: sure:
```json
{
  "tie_word_embeddings": false,
  "model_type": "causal_lm",
  "architectures": ["GPT2LMHeadModel"],
  "head_name": "lm_head_dense"
}
```

aj: converter currently has a hardcoded map expecting head_name == "lm_head". when it doesn't find that key it falls back and drops special token indices (we hit an off-by-one in token id remap).

sophie: logs (trimmed):
```
2026-03-19T14:02:11Z convert: fetching shard 00012 -> 403
2026-03-19T14:02:12Z fetcher: retrying chunk 00012 after token refresh
2026-03-19T14:02:13Z fetcher: wrote /tmp/shard_00012.safetensors
2026-03-19T14:02:13Z concat: appending shards in arrival order (race)
2026-03-19T14:02:14Z convert: checksum mismatch between metadata index and concatenated file
2026-03-19T14:02:15Z converter: weight key lm_head not found -> attempting fallback map -> applied UNKNOWN_RENAME -> token mapping shifted
```

maria: thanks. temporary workaround?

aj: i ran with env CONVERT_FETCH_PARALLEL=1 and pinned --revision=<commit-hash> — conversion finished end-to-end but embeddings misaligned (token id shift +1). so good for testing but not prod.

devon: i pushed a quick change to the fetcher to sort shard filenames before concat if all shard names match the pattern /.*_(\d{5})\.safetensors$/ — that fixed ordering for my run. but still need robust mapping for renamed keys.

sophie: suggested action items: (1) add deterministic concat step that sorts by numeric index, (2) add converter config mapping table for common head renames and warn when unknown, (3) validate special tokens post-conversion against the tokenizer and fail loudly if mismatch, (4) implement token refresh + exponential backoff on 403s when fetching hub shards.

ops-bot: FYI increased staging hub token TTL to 1h (was 15m) to reduce mid-convert expiries.

maria: created GH issue #3421 with logs and repro steps. @devon @aj can you add unit tests for shard ordering and key-rename mapping? i'll follow up on evals run (we need to re-run quant baseline). :eyes:
